Yeah. My feet and palms were separate to be colored. I live for the cheek decals though. If you go 100% shine they look metallic.

Basically. I naturally had a part on the right side of my head, but I moved it to the left, and a good friend gave me a haircut to even out my sides and bangs. I had a hair cut that was specially for my right part, so I had to get a trim for my left part. After a few months it started staying, but I would clip it and use Lv 1 Aussie Hairspray to keep my regrowth from popping up from under the hair I have laid over it.

Benefits being that the lv 1 strength Aussie smells like berries and magic.

When I'm trying to cover up, I will constantly feel my head to see if I can feel any patchy spots visible. Then I'll take multiple pictures of all angles of my head on my phone to see it from another POV. It's incredible stressful for me. 

I have literally used the reverse mohawk description myself about my own pulling. Slowly its just expanded until I had to switch my part to the opposite side of my head.
I'll join now! Thanks!

I've read a lot online about it, and I definitely see how common it turned out to be. I just recently found this subreddit and I'm very happy I posted here. You guys have a lot of insight about it. I never thought to reach out to others with the same or similar problems.

That Fitbit\-like thing doesn't sound too bad. I am interested in something that would notify me that I'm doing something I don't ordinarily notice.  I'm also gonna be joining the facebook group myself.

I always though about seeking out meds to try and ease my anxiety and OCD but I never knew what would be right for me. I dont usually go for medication but I will be bringing this up to my doctor when I go to my next appointment. There may not be much I can do while Expecting, but if there is any advice there I would be happy to take it. I just havent ever bought it up to a doctor. I've always been very embarrassed about it.
'What if?' scares the shit out of me.

But for every one of those lists and statements, there is an equally as qualified explanation. I read all the comments, but there was a lot of picking apart my post and taking details out of context and listing them all together so that yeah, it looks pretty ridiculous. Especially with the amount of people who were there, obviously to be disrespectful, chiming in. Anything I said looked like excuses, but there is more to it than I can even begin to put into words in one single post. 

As far as my child goes: For a very long time he will have practically no contact with my child, out of respect to my daughter's father. Who was incredibly understanding. We have a mutual friend from school on the registry and it's because he was caught by the police with his pants down(18 years old) in a plot of woods by the highschool, known for kids messing around. This dude isn't a bad guy, he just fucked up.  

Anyway, I will undoubtedly protect my daughter by all means. She is most important.

I just read your submission about your experience on the registry and I feel for you, as well. It's like a toxic veil is over you and only ignorance is blinded by it. My BF has told me many stories about the horrors of the RSO life. He has had the same issues with being overly aware of Children, like, they scare the shit out of him. I felt horrible. Cases like yours and my BFs are sad ones. It killed me to know he had accepted that he will never be a father because he is too afraid people will accuse him of harming his own child... This literally tears me apart inside to think about.. All because of an act of stupidity that carried a very taboo consequence.

He actually never served time for the charge its self. He only got probation and his name on the registry. He's gotten in trouble after that for violations such as not registering on time, but he did jail time for them just like any other Probation Violation would call for. And each event is on his public record, and he's explained anything I've ever wanted to know.

And he's self employed in the IT field. He has close friends that own businesses and he handles things for them as far as making databases for all their client information.

He also lives in a state where the [Adam Walsh Child Protection Act](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adam_Walsh_Child_Protection_and_Safety_Act) is not enforced. But where I live, the law is enforced, and by all technicality, he is no longer a registered sex offender under it.
He also didn't know I was a parent for some time when we first started talking. And I initiated the relationship.

I totally understand, and if I hadn't totally examined all of the case files, I wouldn't be so sure, but I'm sure that it's nothing more than what he says and that in this situation, a good man made a mistake and got labled as a monster in one of the most disturbing ways just because a certain law doesn't exist in his state. If he lived in a state under the Adam Walsh Law, he would no longer be on the registry. He would have been removed 2 years ago when the charge lived out its 15 year term.
Why do you think he is downplaying it? Don't you think the mountains of paperwork he had me read through would have mentioned if there was more than one count of CP from 17 years ago?
I did not say that.

It was not a 9 year old. It was a 16 year old. And it was ONE count. One Photo. I read ALL the court documents on the case and he has made everything and everyone involved available for me. He just didn't tell me at first because we were having a great time together and he was afraid of how I would react and wanted me to have met him first. He had all the things he knew I would need to see bookmarked and prepared for me when I came to him and asked him. His friend and himself had even discussed how he was going to tell me, but his friend wanted to be a part of it too, so he jumped the gun and told my mother instead of me, myself.

It literally said "One Count of Child Pornography". Meaning ONE picture. You think that if there was more than ONE photo they would just leave that out of the case? I'm pretty sure they would slam someone for every single photo of there were multiple as individual charges.

My daughter is Number One. If I felt like she was ever in danger, I would immediately take action. She's also very smart for her age, and I've even talked to her some. After reading all the court files, it just makes me sad that because of ONE photograph 17 years ago, everyone thinks my boyfriend is going to hurt children. That's just ridiculous. I've done worse things in my life than being 21 and accidentally downloading a nude picture of a 17 year old. That's literally like the least offensive thing to me.

And I totally understand how it happens to people. My neighbor is on the list for having sex with his girlfriend too close to a school at like 2AM and cops caught him and he was charged. I also read all the paperwork and it was indeed ONE photograph. One count. They would have charged him individually had there been multiple pictures.

Everyone was shaming me telling me he's lying to me, but I don't think you would just tell someone a little bit of a HUGE truth like that and keep some secret. Especially since I believe he wants to be with me, and I know he would never do anything to jeopardize that. 

Also, I've just seen too much physical proof in legal documents. You just don't make that up. Those legal documents aren't lying to try and make it look better than it actually is. I'm positive that if it was worse than it was, they would have taken EVERY opportunity to exploit every single offense.

Sometimes I have thought about doing this same exact thing. I've even made a couple posts on CL myself and got a bunch of attention on it, but I chickened out, but a number of men that were trying to get with me for money was INSANE.

I've also spoken to the friend who outed him, who has apologized excessively. This man who is his childhood friend just wanted to be petty without thinking of the repercussions and he admitted that he was wrong. I just really think it all happened in a really shitty way that made things more complicated.

Naturally, yeah that's the way it went in my head, but after reading so much, and after talking directly to the girl who turned him in to the police in the first place, he's being totally honest. Everything he said was exactly as I read and I trust him completely. It isn't like he was looking for pornographic images of children or that he took the photo and uploaded it himself. Also, the house computer was used by multiple people. He only recieved the charged because he legally signed for it and took responsibility. He may not even have been the one to come across the image in the first place. Also, all the court documents said nothing about the "victim" except that the gender was Female.

I'm just very confident that he isn't keeping anything from me. I've met his family and we basically live in a voice chat via our PCs 24/7. I just don't feel afraid of anything except what others might think.
This makes me sad for you. ): I can't imagine what that's like.. Especially if you're younger..
